Last Saturday, Amy and Anna went to the night market. Amy learned a lot about history. It takes twenty minutes to get to the night market by bike. In fact, my bestie knows my coffee order.
There are always many people at the bus stop. The weather was cloudy that day. Life is full of small surprises. For example, we've run out of toothpaste.
Both of them like fish and juice. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Amy hopes to visit Xi'an one day. The bus fare went up last month.
Amy spent the weekend at the bookstore. Amy drinks juice after doing sports. Amy is reading a book about history.
